ctor.rationale: `base(3, CardType.Power, CardRarity.Rare, TargetType.Self)` (DemonForm.cs:18-21) == cost 3 / POWER / RARE / SELF. No keywords.

CanonicalVars.rationale: `new PowerVar<StrengthPower>(2m)` (DemonForm.cs:16) == `_strength = 2`. Note the var is keyed on StrengthPower but is the amount handed to DEMONFORMPower (DemonForm.cs:26 reads `DynamicVars["StrengthPower"]`), which is what the sim does too -- checked rather than assumed, because the key and the applied power disagree.

OnPlay.rationale: `PowerCmd.Apply<DemonFormPower>(choiceContext, Owner.Creature, DynamicVars["StrengthPower"].BaseValue, Owner.Creature, this)` (DemonForm.cs:26) == `PowerCmd.apply(ctx.hooks, ctx.player, DemonFormPower, self._strength, applier=ctx.player)`. Presentation, folded in: TriggerAnim (25) and the Strength hover tip (14).
